objective: In a fresh session, reconcile the committed blind-calibration effect rows with the provisional audit without using row-count equality as a coverage oracle, compare all seven axes including objective pre-repair hazard coverage, freeze the comparison, apply the unchanged rubric to three temporal reports, and publish the exact adjudication queue without adopting a review template, count, checklist, premortem, or process change.

risk.rationale: The lane is report-only, but a row-identity or axis-comparison mistake can select the wrong intervention or hide an actual disagreement before Claude adjudication.

disallowed_actions: Launch before the exact blind report, row identities, row sets, and comparison base are committed and digest-bound
Resume the blind-classifier, provisional-audit author, intervention-pilot, product-review, or implementation session
Treat equality with 51, or any other row count, as proof of coverage or decomposition quality
Edit, split, merge, delete, or relabel a row in the immutable blind report or provisional audit
Open a temporal report before the complete row reconciliation and per-axis comparison are content-frozen and digest-emitted
Retune a row rule, category, evidence threshold, or unavailable rule after temporal access
Replace unavailable row identity or axis evidence with project-general narrative
Run Cargo, Rust builds, Install, Dogfood, Docker, product mutation, issue mutation, or network calls other than the Fugu provider request
Adopt a review template, checklist, finding quota, repair threshold, premortem requirement, severity policy, routing policy, or process change
Use Codex, Claude, another Fugu session, or subagents as a fallback

non_goals: Review or accept a product/control-plane candidate
Adjudicate conflicting row identities or axis evidence
Reclassify the blind source report in place
Estimate absolute review recall or precision
Complete or reinterpret the frozen intervention pilot
Choose a review-template length, detail level, checklist, item count, or premortem requirement

invariants.statement: The blind calibration and provisional audit remain immutable inputs; row reconciliation and axis comparison are published separately with both source values preserved.
invariants.falsification_test: Edit either source, silently replace a value, or omit an original value or locator from a disputed comparison; postflight rejects the lane.

invariants.statement: Every row-count difference is reconciled by exact report locator, falsifiable effect, subject, evidence, and axis values before any coverage statement.
invariants.falsification_test: Call a blind count wrong because it differs from 51, force splits or merges to equalize counts, or leave a source row unmapped without an explicit relation; comparison fails.

invariants.statement: Every matched row records source values and AGREE, DISAGREE, NON_COMPARABLE, or UNAVAILABLE separately for all seven axes.
invariants.falsification_test: Let one narrative primary cause substitute for seven axes, infer hazard foreseeability from hindsight, or convert agent agreement into evidence; comparison fails.

invariants.statement: The normalized row map, rules, per-axis comparison, disagreements, unavailable values, and aggregates are digest-frozen before any temporal report is opened.
invariants.falsification_test: Open a temporal report first, change the freeze after temporal access, or retune a rule from temporal outcomes; temporal evidence is invalid.

invariants.statement: The queue contains exactly decision-relevant row/axis disagreements, reproduced effects, decision-critical unavailable values, policy/contradiction rows, and denominator-changing split/merge decisions.
invariants.falsification_test: Omit a required item or add agreed non-decision-critical rows for volume; queue completeness fails.

invariants.statement: The lane changes only its comparison report and cannot adopt a process, template, checklist, count, policy, or candidate disposition.
invariants.falsification_test: Change another path or state a permanent process decision; postflight rejects the lane.

validation.command: Before launch, bind and recompute the blind report commit/tree/path/bytes/SHA-256, row count and identity digest, reproduced-effect set, decision-critical-unavailable set, and exact comparison base.
validation.purpose: Prevent comparison against a moving, incomplete, or substituted blind source.

validation.command: Mechanically verify every blind and provisional row appears in exactly one declared relation and every normalized row has both source locators or an explicit one-sided reason.
validation.purpose: Prevent numerical count matching from hiding omissions, duplicate mappings, or unjustified splits.

validation.command: Before temporal access, emit the complete comparison-freeze byte count and SHA-256 in one event-log result and verify the same digest at handoff.
After the comparison freeze, classify b3de0d7/02e04c7, 5760c98/0944bf3, and b589864/aaa39b6 under unchanged rules and report every unavailable value.
validation.purpose: Check whether calibration evidence patterns survive later reports without tuning.

validation.command: Mechanically compare the published adjudication queue against all required disagreement, reproduced-effect, unavailable, policy/contradiction, and denominator-sensitive inputs.
validation.purpose: Keep later adjudication finite without losing decision-relevant evidence.
Keep the report-only AI control plane structurally valid.
Validate report links and project documentation structure.

validation.command: git diff --check; git diff --name-only <launch-revision>..HEAD and git status --porcelain must show only the committed comparison report and a clean worktree.
